title: A JSON cloning shortcut changes dates and drops undefined fields
request: Fix cloneRecord(value) in src/clone.mjs. Deeply copy arrays, plain objects, Date values and primitive values, retaining own enumerable string keys with undefined values. Nested mutable data and Dates must be independent. Reject cyclic structures and unsupported object types such as Map and Set with TypeError. Repeated references without a cycle are allowed. Preserve the check file.
seededFailure: JSON serialization silently converts Dates to strings and drops undefined-valued fields. A structuredClone shortcut repairs those examples but accepts cycles and unsupported object types outside this API contract.
